scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean && shx rm -rf artifacts apps/demo-web/dist extensions/fixture-provider/dist
scripts.vscode:types:update: pnpm --dir apps/demo-web exec dts dev 1.138.0 && shx rm -f "types/vscode-proposed/vscode.proposed.*.d.ts" && shx mv "apps/demo-web/vscode.proposed.*.d.ts" types/vscode-proposed/
scripts.lint:deps: dependency-cruiser packages adapters apps extensions --config dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err-long
scripts.lint: pnpm check:biome && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm lint:deadcode && pnpm lint:docs && pnpm lint:markdown
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --import ./tests/vscode-runtime/register-vscode-stub.mjs --test tests/adapter/*.test.mjs tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/vscode/*.test.mjs tests/vscode-runtime/*.test.mjs tests/history/*.test.mjs tests/http/*.test.mjs tests/github/github-adapter.test.mjs tests/meta/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:adapter: pnpm build && node --import ./tests/vscode-runtime/register-vscode-stub.mjs --test tests/adapter/*.test.mjs tests/http/*.test.mjs tests/github/github-adapter.test.mjs
scripts.test:github-live: pnpm build && cross-env REMOTISH_LIVE_GITHUB=1 node --test tests/github/github-live.test.mjs
scripts.test:vscode-web: pnpm bundle:demo && pnpm bundle:fixture-provider:extension && pnpm bundle:demo:tests && vscode-test-web --browserType=chromium --headless=true --extensionDevelopmentPath=apps/demo-web --extensionTestsPath=apps/demo-web/dist/test/suite/index.js --extensionPath=extensions/fixture-provider
scripts.release:source: shx mkdir -p artifacts && git archive --format=tar.gz --output=artifacts/remotish-framework.tar.gz HEAD
scripts.ci: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test && shx mkdir -p artifacts && pnpm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --sbom-spec-version 1.6 --sbom-type application --prod --lockfile-only --out artifacts/remotish.cdx.json
scripts.release:vsix: shx rm -rf apps/demo-web/dist && pnpm bundle:demo && shx mkdir -p artifacts && pnpm --dir apps/demo-web exec vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../../artifacts/remotish.vsix
scripts.test:vscode-web:vsix: pnpm release:vsix && pnpm release:fixture-provider:vsix && pnpm bundle:demo:tests && pnpm prepare:vscode-web-vsix && vscode-test-web --browserType=chromium --headless=true --extensionDevelopmentPath=artifacts/vsix-smoke/extension --extensionTestsPath=artifacts/vsix-smoke/extension/dist/test/suite/vsix.js --extensionPath=artifacts/vsix-smoke/providers && shx rm -rf artifacts/vsix-smoke
scripts.release:fixture-provider:vsix: shx rm -rf extensions/fixture-provider/dist && pnpm build && pnpm bundle:fixture-provider:extension && shx mkdir -p artifacts && pnpm --dir extensions/fixture-provider exec vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../../artifacts/remotish-fixture-provider.vsix
